identity.name: Xaero Minimap × EMF Entity Icon Compatibility

goals: Repair demonstrated Fresh Animations entity-head failures through the narrow EMF-to-Xaero adapter; retain exact Canary 3 as failed/partial provenance after withdrawal of its aggregate pass.
Keep the generic EMF-to-Xaero trace and canonical-frame adapter narrow, fail-closed, and free of species-specific offsets, replacement renderers, or new icon behavior.
Retain exact unsuccessful diagnostic and canary evidence without reclassifying incomplete or failed observations as passes.
scope: Maintain the custom EMF trace bridge and icon-only canonical-frame adapter after ordinary Xaero prerender returns empty; follow bounded recursive head/head_parts identity paths through the retained vanilla root or EMFModelPartVanilla's public retained-root route.

Follow a unique zero-transform retained geometry owner when the canonical container is empty, or detach direct canonical EMF head geometry into a plain ModelPart with only explicit facial/headwear anchors. The traced detached head itself is renderable even when EMF marks its traversal node skipDraw; named descendants retain their own transforms and visibility. Exclude body siblings, and fail closed on ambiguous, non-finite, singular, untraced, non-head, vanilla or upstream-success paths.

Retain exact Diagnostic1 and Canary 1 through Canary 7 artifacts. Validate reported entity structures with exact retained C3/C4 provenance alongside sheep, horse, sea turtle and creeper controls. Bound normal Fabric diagnostics, invalidate only observed EMF entity-type successful/failed icon caches on reload, and retry one already-cached FAILED value only after the current LivingEntity renderer is structurally confirmed as an EMF root.

exclusions: Species-specific screen offsets, broad renderer redesign, whole-body icons, live model mutation, and unsupported claims about unreported cases.
Changes to upstream Xaero, Fresh Animations, EMF, ETF or other projects except the explicitly owned Ribbits icon companion integration in this reconciliation.
Static mob icons, copied upstream assets or classes, replacement entity rendering, networking, server behavior, and redistribution of Xaero's All Rights Reserved content.
The retired Diagnostic2 source workspace, unretained generated outputs, legacy status narratives, Test Instance Manager state, deployment ledgers, snapshots, and historical administrative matrices.
Runtime deployment, Minecraft launch, either Test Slot, accepted-baseline mutation, map-data changes, and access to the protected gameplay instance during this migration.
Dedicated-server, exhaustive all-mob, per-check Canary 3, or other runtime validation not present in the frozen evidence.
